### More Than a Babe in a Manger
Author: Michael Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-november-29.html
Passage: Psalm 2:1-12
Points:
- Jesus' coming as the reigning Messiah was promised and purposed throughout the Old Testament Scriptures.
- Modern culture still rebels against divine authority, attempting to discard God's standards to pursue self-rule.
- Christ is not merely an infant in a manger, but the exalted King and sovereign Judge over all nations.
- God extends an invitation of grace even to His adversaries, urging them to turn from rebellion.
- Destruction awaits those who reject the Son, while blessing and security belong to those taking refuge in Him.

### Opposing the Lord's Annointed
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/opposing-lords-annointed
Passage: Psalm 2:1-6
Points:
- The designation of the Lord's Anointed finds its ultimate fulfillment in Jesus Christ.
- Human rulers and earthly nations plot against divine rule, but their efforts are entirely futile.
- Opposing the authority of God's appointed King is equivalent to making war against God Himself.
- True covenant submission requires wholehearted allegiance to Christ, the sinless and perfect King.
- Believers need not fear worldly opposition because Christ actively defends His people and conquers all enemies.
